title: ASTRID - An Automated and Scalable TRIaD for the Evaluation of RAG-based Clinical Question Answering Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety engineering and clinical safety metrics (such as clinical harm and appropriateness) for medical question answering. While these involve professional medical ethics, the study's core component is technical benchmarking of RAG accuracy and safety in a clinical setting, rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious, spiritual, or general moral/ethical frameworks.
